items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a dualizing complex on a locally Noetherian algebraic space is coherent and that the internal hom into it induces an anti-equivalence of the coherent derived category with a canonical double duality isomorphism, exchanging the boundedness properties in the quasi-compact case (statement lines 390-405). The proof (proof lines 406-440) reduces to affine etale charts, uses affine duality and the corresponding statements for a dualizing complex over a ring, and transfers them by compatibility of internal hom with restriction. H3: a chart-by-chart reduction written out in full.
